After introducing and planting the first variety, the method for transplanting different tomato varieties is described (subtask 2).
The method for transplanting is then applied to the specific cherry and grape tomatoes (subtask 3).

After planting the heirloom tomato, another tomato variety is planted by a helper (subtask 5).
Finally, the preparation and planting of the last tomato variety are described (subtask 6).
